summary: Learn AI for Finance with practical audit, reporting, and governance tools. Build confidence in analysis, controls, and management reporting.
lede: AI for Finance, Audit and Management Reporting applies machine learning, automation, and AI-supported analytics to finance, audit, and management reporting workflows. It helps professionals prepare data, identify anomalies, interpret variances, validate audit evidence, and develop management commentary with a clear review trail. The course provides practical methods for creating finance analysis prompts, structuring exception tests, building risk and control checklists, and identifying suitable points for automation in the close or audit cycle. It also introduces model risk, explainability, and governance concepts so teams can improve reporting efficiency while maintaining defensible evidence and controlled processes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who need to apply AI in reporting, audit, and performance analysis without losing control discipline.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of finance, audit, or management reporting processes and basic comfort with spreadsheets and financial analysis. You do not need programming experience, but you should be able to interpret tables, charts, reconciliations, and control evidence. Familiarity with month-end close, variance analysis, internal audit testing, or management reporting packs will help you get more value from the applied exercises. Advanced AI concepts will be covered at an operational application level, not as technical engineering.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
